title: API v1 is removed
detail: This path was part of the Sourcify API v1. API v1 is removed. Use API v2.
rules: Request only the fields that you need, for example fields=abi or fields=sources.
For data on many contracts, use the free Parquet export or the BigQuery dataset.
Send a descriptive User-Agent with your tool name, version, and a contact URL or email.
